examples.name: Sample — a band that says Cont'd
paragraphs: SELF-INSURED / $1 MILLION TO $3 MILLION CATEGORY – Cont'd as a band under the heading of a scanned schedule. It is boxed on its own, apart from the table frame, so it is a title above the table, kept with its marker. Each fund spans several printed lines, one benefit per line, with X marks in the INSURED, SELF-INSURED and three COVERAGE columns; the fund-name cell is one merged cell beside its benefit rows.
